purpose: Find occupation counts finer than ISCO-08 two digits and longitudinal C/N mobility without mixing incompatible populations or years.

target_population.name: Portugal all employed persons age 15+, 2024, both sexes

detailed_occupation_evidence.population: All employed Portuguese residents aged 15+, national LFS
limitations: 43 submajor 2-digit groups; OC63 and NRP not available as subcategory counts
17 two-digit groups in verified-copies crosswalk contain C and N links, covering 2363.6 thousand employed
No within-group 3/4-digit counts here
404 on attempted *dataset codes* is not evidence that no data exist under any other code or confidentiality procedure

detailed_occupation_evidence.occupational_resolution: Detailed occupation breakdown available in underlying personnel records; exact published Excel table-level CPP resolution not verified
detailed_occupation_evidence.population: Employer-reported dependent workers in covered private firms and state-owned enterprises, not the national all-employed population
limitations: Exclude self-employment, most public administrative sector, and domestic service
Do not use QP subgroup fractions directly as national LFS occupation weights without denominator reconciliation and bias analysis
Official published files were not read programmatically in this study

detailed_occupation_evidence.publisher: Brighter Future / Fundação Belmiro de Azevedo
detailed_occupation_evidence.occupational_resolution: 1,802 listed occupation profiles at time of inspection, mixes aggregated and detailed professions and does not furnish a validated 2024 code-by-code bulk table
limitations: Displayed occupation-worker counts on listing do not specify historical reference year, so no undated profile counts are transferred to 2024
No verified crosswalk from displayed profession slugs to four-digit ISCO codes or a bulk 2024 table
Dynamic employment charts were not extracted as auditable source data
Do not sum 1802 occupational profiles, since detail and aggregate classifications may overlap

detailed_occupation_evidence.publisher: Brighter Future / Fundação Belmiro de Azevedo
detailed_occupation_evidence.population: Workers in enterprises according to the QP-based analytical publication
limitations: Approximate company-worker count, not Eurostat employed age-15-plus total
Do not treat 3.65/5.1123 as a random sampling fraction or weight profession mixes without employer/state/self-employed reconciliation

detailed_occupation_evidence.occupational_resolution: ISCO-08 3-digit available in scientific-use microdata with restrictions
limitations: Not directly publicly downloadable without approved research access
Scientific-use anonymized identifiers are not suitable for straightforward individual longitudinal linkage across waves
Sample sizes, cell suppression, questionnaire and ISCO provenance must be checked

detailed_occupation_evidence.occupational_resolution: Census occupational categories, not verified at all 2021 3/4-digit numeric national counts
limitations: Not a 2024 baseline
Previous public INE tables found use major CPP occupational groups
Any 2021 fine-grained allocation for 2024 needs tested stability/bias conditions

observed_occupational_mobility.publisher: Brighter Future; QP administrative matched-worker analysis
observed_occupational_mobility.denominator: Workers present in QP linked personnel data in both the starting and the final years; excludes those lost to observation
observed_occupational_mobility.type: Observed reported occupational category change (not necessarily employment-group C to N movement)
limitations: Earlier 2020-2022 transition, not 2024 and not monthly
Matched-worker survivor sample, excludes those not seen at both times including exits and transitions to sectors outside coverage
A transition between detailed occupations may be absorbed by the broader Brighter Future profession grouping
Marginal all-occupational switching percentage does not identify C→N or N→C flow matrix
Original model mu_bar and mu are cross-occupational effective search discounts, not observed job-switch shares
No worker-level anonymized transition records or public C/N-specific matrix obtained

unresolved_critical_inputs.need: Occupation counts weighted at ISCO-08 3/4-digit within 17 mixed ISCO2 groups, verified SOC mappings, explicit treatment of 26 ISCO4 units mapping to both C and N
Monthly origin C/N to destination C/N job-finding and search-efficiency relation, using proper linked worker/unemployment data
Explicit future search-discount path separate from observed 2020-2022 occupational switching
Full monthly quits/separations including employer-to-employer moves, not just matched employees' change of occupational label

method_decision: Keep country audit non-executable and do not combine QP employer population, 2020-2022 switchers, 2021 census categories or undated profession profiles with official Eurostat 2024 all-employed denominator as if directly equivalent.
